claim: Patchline ships a throughput-per-dollar frontier with a proven cost lower bound across instance families. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the throughput-per-dollar frontier claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make throughput-per-dollar-frontier-gate`.
